correctness.rationale: All classical complete strict profiles for n=2 (16) and n=3 (6^6=46656) can be exhaustively enumerated since each profile has n! possible perfect matchings. Independent exact implementation tested blocking pairs and full argmin sets, confirming 40056 equality, 5400 proper E subset G, and 1200 proper G subset E, with zero disjoint/nonnested cases. Stable-matching multiplicities by 1/2/3 were 34080/11484/1092. For the explicit four-couple witness direct enumeration of all 24 assignments found exactly two stable matchings with ranks (2,4,3,1,1,1,2,1) and (2,2,2,1,3,1,2,3), objectives (15,4) and (16,3), disjoint singleton argmins. Exhaustive enumeration is a complete finite proof for n≤3, not an infinite extrapolation.
residual_risks: The n=4 claim is only existence of an explicit witness, not the n=4 full profile census.
No assertion for preferences with ties, incomplete lists or n>4.
